hints.title: Subarray Sum Violation
hints.text: Every continuous subsegment of length greater than two must have a strictly positive total sum.

hints.title: Running Prefix Tracking
hints.text: Track the cumulative sum and the maximal prefix sum in the current window.

hints.title: Greedy Boundary Reset
hints.text: When a violation occurs on a window of length greater than two, replace the current element with a large value and reset window tracking.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass greedy prefix sum tracking resets upon detected violations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all subarrays of length exceeding two takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy resets require only scalar accumulation variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the greedy choice property where resetting the latest element resolves prior violations.
